scope: Local development findings; each public receipt independently regenerates final evidence.

cases.finding: The initial authored rim proxy bottom used declared rim height minus 25 mm, with 35 mm thickness, so its top was 10 mm too high.
cases.resolution: Set its bottom to declared rim height minus its actual 35 mm thickness. Export actual evaluated floor/seat/rim world vertices in native and saved-scene observations.
cases.acceptance_limit: Agreement with a static proxy plane does not qualify palm/skin contact, body collision or load support. Body-only GLB explicitly omits context geometry.

cases.finding: The reusable ground consumer's empty shoe list and zero shoe-error fields could be mistaken for aquatic footwear evidence.
cases.resolution: Remove unused footwear material/export/check paths and declare both source bodies barefoot, retaining historical case labels only as source provenance.
cases.acceptance_limit: No aquatic shoe or stiletto acceptance transfers from earlier ground experiments.

cases.prior_provider_conclusion: SUCCESS; authored-sample and two fixed off-key checks missed the defect
cases.finding: Four crawl upper-arm native action keys change between equivalent q and -q signs. LINEAR component interpolation can rotate through the wrong path; the body GLB exporter already used continuous signs.

negative_evidence.scope: Between-key original native action versus already sign-continuous exported GLB; preserved development negative

cases.resolution: Align each native bone quaternion key to the previous hemisphere. Record raw sign transitions and add each actual transition midpoint to native saved-scene and GLB transport probes.
cases.acceptance_limit: This qualifies the observed crossing probes and authored samples, not every continuous-time seek or realistic motion.

corrected_local_full_vertex_witness.scope: Between-key sign-continuous native action versus exported GLB; full corresponding-vertex correction witness
